messages:
devops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: hosted-api-us-west queue growth > 5x baseline, p95 latency spiking to 1.8s and p99 > 6s. Autoscaler attempted 6 scale actions and failed 5 times (provisioner error). Root thread: 1745004321

irene: i'm oncall, paging infra and runtime. Observed backlog ~18k reqs across frontends. some customers report timeouts.

maria: looking at provisioner logs now. getting `QuotaExceeded: GPU quota` from cloud provider during node create. provisioner retries but hits 429/403 from cloud API.

sam: confirm cloud project GPU quota shows 0 spare accelerators. There's a pending quota request that hasn't been approved. region us-west-2 is capped.

kevin: runtime is holding requests in RTU queue; eviction is happening but new capacity never arrives. Fallback routing to cpu-quantized models is enabled but only for new requests; existing backlog still on GPU queue.

irene: estimate customer impact: p95 requests degraded for all hosted tier customers in us-west, some enterprise customers seeing timeouts. CS pinged sales to prepare comms.

cs-agent: we have 3 enterprise customers in the affected region seeing multiple 504s. they're asking for ETA.

maria: trying a manual workaround: force the autoscaler to prefer any available thin-pool (non-GPU) fallback instance to drain the queue to reduce tail latency. This will increase CPU cost but buys time. applying now.

kevin: enabling fallback route `/models/quantized-small` for route groups heavy-client-* to divert heavy long-seq requests. patch:

```
route.override("heavy-client-*") {
  preferred_model: "quantized-small",
  fallback: true
}
```

Will roll this in canary to 10% first.

sam: infra note: we can temporarily borrow GPUs from our sandbox project but need approvals. who has billing approval? @sales might know customer impact tolerance for cost.

sales: i can sign off for emergency short-term capacity to protect enterprise SLAs. need to confirm exact cost. pinging finance.

maria: also seeing provisioner crash loop on create calls, error snippet:

```
2025-06-21T02:15:09Z provisioner error createNode(): http 403 QuotaExceeded: RequestLimitExceeded
stack: createNode -> createInstance -> cloudAPI
```

Those 403s cause autoscaler backoff and prevent further attempts.

irene: escalation path: sam + maria triage cloud quota with provider support, kevin to implement routing fallback, sales/CS do customer comms. i'll mark incident Sev1 and open incident-doc.

devops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20250621-1745004321, Pager duty alert acknowledged by irene.

sam: opened support case with cloud (case #CLD-8892) requesting temporary quota uplift for accelerators in us-west-2. elevated to urgent. ETA from provider 3-6 hours.

kevin: to reduce impact now, i pushed canary routing to 30% and enabled request shedding for non-authenticated/anonymous heavy traffic. small config:

```
traffic_shaper {
  threshold: 1200rps
  action: shed(low_priority)
}
```

we're seeing immediate drop in tail p99 from 6s -> 3.2s for canaryed traffic.

maria: also preparing a manual node bootstrap into alternative region eu-west-1 and update DNS/routing for client subset. that requires config change and some customers can't failover cross-region. marking as fallback option.

cs-agent: updating customers now: "we're actively mitigating by routing traffic and enabling fallbacks; we will provide follow-up when quota uplift completes." asked for sample mitigation steps for CS playbook.

irene: handoff to night oncall @maria in 30m if this is stable. otherwise keep paging. next steps for handoff: track cloud support, monitor backlog drain, confirm enterprise customers' impact.

maria: current metrics 20m after mitigations: backlog down from 18k -> 6.1k, p95 1.8s -> 1.1s, p99 6s -> 2.9s. autoscaler still blocked on quota.

sam: cloud updated: temporary quota granted for +40 GPUs for 2 hours but needs us to migrate some non-prod capacity out. applying changes now.

kevin: allocating temporary pool and updating routing. pushing a hotfix to provisioner to bypass excessive backoff when responses are 403 vs 429. patch posted to repo and rolling restart in 2 mins.

maria: confirmed provisioner now creating nodes successfully using temporary quota. autoscaler recovered and created 18 GPUs. queue drain accelerated.

devops-bot: :white_check_mark: Autoscaler state: healthy. backlog now 400 reqs. p95 220ms, p99 980ms. Incident downgraded to Sev2.

irene: great. action items:
- sam: follow up with cloud on permanent quota request and billing (CLD-8892)
- kevin: postmortem for provisioner backoff logic + small hotfix PR (link to PR)
- maria: update runbook to include quota prechecks before autoscale and emergency thin-pool flow
- cs-agent & sales: customer followups and SLA credits if required

sales: will draft customer comms and coordinate with CS.

maria: preparing summary for postmortem. adding logs, timeline, metrics and the code patch diff.

irene: handing off final monitoring to maria for next 2h, oncall rotation unpaused. if any regression -> re-page all.

cs-agent: customers notified, one customer requested detailed incident report. adding to postmortem ask.

kevin: also will add a protective guard to the autoscaler to detect sustained cloud 4xx/5xx and route to fallback sooner.

devops-bot: Incident INC-20250621-1745004321 status: resolved->monitoring.

maria: logging final note: root cause = exhausted GPU quota + aggressive provisioner backoff on 403s which blocked autoscaler retries; mitigation = temporary quota uplift, routing fallbacks, provisioner hotfix. will schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

irene: thanks team. nice rapid coordination. :thumbsup:
